Travel Beyond Bengaluru, Worry-Free

Satya Tourists offers safe, comfortable, and affordable outstation taxi services from Bengaluru to destinations across South India. Whether it's a weekend getaway to Mysore and Coorg, a family pilgrimage to Tirupati, or a long road trip to Goa, our well-maintained fleet and experienced drivers make sure every kilometre is comfortable.

Choose from Sedans, SUVs, Innova Crysta, Tempo Travellers, Mini Buses, and large coaches — all with transparent, per-km pricing and no hidden charges.
